property_summary: For any caller that locked a guess and then calls settle, the reference contract always resets their stored guess.block to 0 after settle returns; the mutant leaves guess.block nonzero when the guess was incorrect (so the property is violated for some inputs).
change_summary: Move the line that zeroes the stored block to after the conditional so the stored block is only cleared when the guess matches the answer (i.e., when transfer occurs).
